commands.blocking_environment: Local runner has Java 17 and no Gradle 8.14.3; repository requires Java 21 and Gradle 8.14.3. The exact Java/Testcontainers check is required on CI.

source_assertions: V002 is forward-only and adds stable UUIDv7 primary keys, bounded unique slugs, unique editorial positions, optimistic versions and restrictive publication-state checks.

The public SQL projection enforces PUBLISHED issue/article state, due publication time, READY media, non-empty alt text, server-selected safe cover keys and currently valid PUBLIC_WEB rights before mapping a response.
Collection pagination uses a bounded opaque cursor and the keyset predicate (published_at, id) < (?, ?), with limit + 1 rather than an unbounded offset query.
The detail projection returns only ordered public sections/articles and fails closed when its bounded TOC cap is exceeded.
Public responses use representation-specific SHA-256 ETags, 304 handling, 60-second public must-revalidate caching and no-store Problem Details.
Malformed ISO-8601 cursor timestamps are classified as INVALID_REQUEST rather than escaping as a 500 response.
The controller resolves JdbcTemplate at request time so component-scan ordering cannot suppress the endpoint before JDBC auto-configuration registers the template.
remaining_required_proof: Run the Java 21 Testcontainers integration suite, Checkstyle and SpotBugs on the exact PR head.
Apply V002 against the CI PostgreSQL 18 image.
next_action: Push the immutable review head and use exact-head CI as the authority for Java and migration execution.
